scripts.client:start:ready: npm run wait:server && npm run client:start
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,client -c blue,magentaBright "npm run server:start" "npm run client:start:ready"
scripts.dev:watch: concurrently -k -n server,client -c blue,magentaBright "npm run server:dev" "npm run client:start:ready"
scripts.build: npm run client:build && npm run server:build
scripts.heroku-postbuild: npm ci --prefix client && npm ci --prefix server && npm run build
scripts.typecheck: npm run client:typecheck && npm run server:typecheck
scripts.bootstrap: npm install && npm install --prefix client && npm install --prefix server
scripts.ci: npm ci && npm ci --prefix client && npm ci --prefix server
